verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows a code-view editor for direct code edits (bolt-docs-1, bolt-docs-3, bolt-docs-17, bolt-docs-25) and prompt-based iteration; there is no mention of a visual 'select an element and edit text/style/layout' interface that avoids a prompt round-trip. Community notes confirm most edits happen via prompts (bolt-comm-10), reinforcing the lack of direct visual editing.
